items.text:
Here’s the real formula I use inside my Microbakery Blueprint 👇
1️⃣ Add up every ingredient and packaging cost per item.
2️⃣ Multiply your total anywhere from 2.5× to 5× depending on the product.
 → Simpler items like mixes or pecans = closer to 2.5×
 → Labor-heavy goods like cookies, sourdough, or bundles = 4–5×
3️⃣ That’s your retail price — and yes, it should include your time, utilities, and profit.

Because you’re not just baking — you’re building something sustainable.

💬 Comment “PRICING” if you want my full breakdown next.

Welcome to the offical Micro bakery tiktok acount✨

If you are new here our bakery specializes in acient sounrdough which is made from just 3 ingredients flour, water and salt. We aim to bring you the essence of authentic sourdough, traditional baking practices using heritage grains freshly milled and sourced from British trusted farms.

We also have fresh sweet and savory goods that are made daily! Such as, sausage rolls diffrent variations of quiche and sour dough sandwiches, on the sweet side we have many diffrent flavoured pastries we would love for you to try!
